article_title: Cancel and no-show policy for riders

summary: Explains refund and return policy for grocery and other retailer orders. Customers can self-report order problems within 3 days of pickup or delivery, excluding restaurant orders, for a credit or refund. Missing or damaged items may be eligible for refund or credit up to the amount paid.

Explains trial auto-enrollment into paid plans; charges may be applied up to 6 hours prior to renewal and are refundable per Instacart+ Terms. Covers updating payment method, plan changes, and cancellation steps. States that for ANNUAL members, the rider may cancel within the first 5 calendar days of the paid Instacart+ membership for a refund of the membership fee, only if they have not placed any orders using Instacart+. If canceled at any other time, no refund — but the user keeps $0 delivery fees through the end of the billing period.
user_action_required: Open the app or web menu, select Your Instacart+ membership, choose Cancel membership, confirm cancellation. Watch for the cancellation confirmation email.
policy_conditions: Annual members: 5-calendar-day refund window if no orders used Instacart+ benefits. Otherwise no refund; benefits continue through billing period. Charges may apply up to 6 hours before renewal and are refundable per Terms.
refund_or_credit_language: Refund eligibility is explicitly conditional on annual membership, 5-day window, and no orders using Instacart+.
escalation_path: Login-gated 'Still need help?' path. No phone number on this article.
account_specific_dependency: Yes. Refund depends on membership type, days since charge, and Instacart+ usage.
